package.name: so101_yolo_demo
package.description: CPU-capable YOLOv8n object/person detection demo for the SO-101. The "swap the model, get a different demo" sibling of so101_depth_demo: same ONNX Runtime CPU inference pattern and camera input, but detects objects (person, by default) instead of estimating depth. Feeds so101_safety's person_safety_monitor, which raises the same /safety/protective_stop contract as depth_safety_monitor so the enforcement nodes (safety_pause_bridge / trajectory_safety_gate) never change.
